_note_injection: Raised from 0.25 to 0.6 on 2026-08-27 after finding a ~40% false-positive rate on benign, instruction-style CVE-detail questions (e.g. numbered '(1)...(2)...(3)' report templates, imperative SAST/audit phrasing) scoring 0.25-0.41. Verified via offline replay against src/secai_gateway/sanitize/classifier.py: real injection/jailbreak prompts (ignore-instructions, DAN jailbreak, prompt extraction, tool abuse, delimiter escape) scored 0.868-0.9997 — wide margin above the highest observed false positive (0.4138). metrics.json's own reported precision/recall for injection@0.25 (0.9667/1.0 on n=383 held-out) reflects the training distribution, not the templated/instructional phrasing that triggered the false positives seen in production — this threshold change is a mitigation, not a full fix; the head likely needs retraining with more diverse benign instructional/imperative examples to fully close the generalization gap.
